h1: Panviman Resort Koh Phangan — a hillside beachfront resort above Thong Nai Pan Noi where a golf buggy ferries you down to a private beach
intro: Thong Nai Pan Noi, on the north coast of Koh Phangan, is a quiet crescent of white sand tucked far from the buzz of Haad Rin · At the far end a green headland slopes into the sea, and that is where Panviman Resort Koh Phangan sits — a 5-star resort built in tiers from the clifftop down to the shore · 94 rooms and villas, from hotel-style rooms to ocean-view pool villas, with a private beach and golf-buggy transfers throughout · from approx. ฿2,800/night · 8.4 from 1,782 reviews on Booking.com.

body.html: Panviman has been on Koh Phangan for a long time — it opened back in the late 1980s and has been refurbished in stages ever since · What sets it apart from other resorts on the same beach is its hillside setting, built in tiers from the top of the headland down to the shore, which gives many rooms sweeping 360° ocean views · The resort has 94 rooms and villas, from compact hotel-style rooms up to ocean-view pool villas, spread across the slope · Because the terrain is steep, there are golf buggies that shuttle guests between rooms, pools, restaurants and the beach all day.

There is a genuinely wide spread of room types · It starts with the Superior Hotel (28 sqm) and Deluxe Hotel (40 sqm) — accessible hotel-style rooms — and goes up to the Pool Villa and Executive Pool Suite (88 sqm) with private pools and ocean views · Many rooms have large balconies and an indoor or outdoor bathtub · Guests often praise the spacious rooms, the views, and the pillow menu · But there are also comments that some rooms feel dated, with furnishings that have clearly seen years of use — something to accept at a resort that has been open this long.
"Our room was up on the hill, and opening the balcony you see the whole bay. We had coffee out there watching the sunrise. Staff sent a buggy down to the beach for us whenever we asked."

What reviews mention most is the staff service and the private beach · Guests describe the staff as friendly and helpful, sending a buggy round whenever needed · The beach in front of the resort is a quiet, clear private stretch with free kayaks and snorkelling gear to borrow · On the food side there is a beachfront restaurant and a hillside restaurant with sea views; breakfast draws both praise and criticism — some find it fresh with plenty of choice, others say quality can be inconsistent.

Facilities are fairly complete for a resort this size · There is an ocean-view infinity pool, the hilltop Panviman Spa, a large fitness centre, a kids club, and water activities · The spa leans on Thai massage and herbal treatments, fitting Koh Phangan's wellness image · The kids club and children's activities make this a better fit for families than resorts aimed purely at couples · Overall it is a place you can stay in all day without leaving, with the beach, pools, spa and restaurants all on site.

There are several things worth saying plainly · First, the terrain is very steep — even with the buggies you sometimes face a lot of steps, so anyone with mobility issues or travelling with elderly guests should request a lower room near the beach · Second, the décor and some furnishings show their age, and a few guests feel the price is high relative to condition · Third, there are reviews about inconsistent cleanliness in some rooms, so check yours on arrival · And the water in front of the beach sometimes mixes with fresh-water runoff · It scores 8.4 from 1,782 reviews on Booking.com and 4.6/5 on TripAdvisor (ranked #3 in Ban Tai · Travelers' Choice 2026) — clearly positive overall, but with honest notes on condition and price.

Getting there takes some planning, as anywhere on the north coast · Thong Nai Pan Noi is about 45 minutes to an hour by road from Thong Sala pier, and the final stretch is a winding climb over the hills · The resort runs a paid transfer from the pier, which most guests use rather than driving themselves · If you fly into Samui (USM) and ferry over to Thong Sala, allow roughly 2–2.5 hours door to door · Once you arrive you won't want to leave much, since the beach and resort cover everything.

Bottom line: Panviman suits travellers who want a private-beach, sea-view resort that is easier on the wallet than the pure luxury pool villas — families, couples, or anyone escaping the crowds for the quiet north coast · Rooms run from entry-level hotel rooms to pool villas, so you can match it to your budget · It is not for guests who struggle with steps and slopes, those who care most about pristine new furnishings, or anyone here for the Full Moon party, since it sits far from Haad Rin · But if the brief is a wide sea view and a quiet beach at a price you can still reach, it stands out in its class.

honestSummary: Panviman Resort Koh Phangan suits travellers after a private-beach, sea-view resort on Koh Phangan's north coast that is more affordable than the pure luxury pool villas — a hillside setting with wide views, a quiet beach, good service, buggy transfers and a kids club · But accept that the terrain is steep with plenty of steps, some rooms are dated, and the location is remote on the north coast.
honestChecks: If you struggle with steps and slopes, or travel with elderly guests or small children — the resort is steep with many stairs despite the buggies → request a lower room near the beach and pool at the time of booking.

If you care most about new, pristine rooms and furnishings — this is a long-established resort and some rooms are dated → choose a recently refurbished category such as Pool Villa / Executive Pool Suite and check recent review photos before booking.

If you're coming to Koh Phangan for the Full Moon party or nightlife — it sits on the north coast, far from Haad Rin, so you'll need a cross-island ride → pick somewhere near Haad Rin or Thong Sala instead if partying is the point.

tips.title: Don't hesitate to call a buggy
tips.body: The resort is steep — don't force the walk up and down. Call the front desk for a golf buggy between your room, the pools, restaurants and the beach anytime.

tips.title: Ask for a sea-view room
tips.body: The charm here is the hillside sea view. Note at booking that you want an ocean-facing room — it's well worth it over a garden/hill view.

tips.title: Borrow free kayaks / snorkel gear
tips.body: The private beach has free kayaks and snorkelling gear. Mornings are calm and clear — ideal for paddling and snorkelling the reef along the shore.

tips.title: Use the resort transfer from the pier
tips.body: The road from Thong Sala pier is a winding 45 min–1 hr climb. Booking the resort's transfer is easier and safer than driving it yourself.

faqTitle: Frequently Asked Questions — Panviman Resort Koh Phangan

faq.q: Where is Panviman Resort Koh Phangan and how do you get there?
faq.a: It sits on the hillside above Thong Nai Pan Noi beach on the north coast of Koh Phangan · It's about 45 minutes to an hour by road from Thong Sala pier, with a winding climb on the final stretch · The resort offers a paid transfer from the pier · If you fly into Samui Airport and ferry over, allow roughly 2–2.5 hours door to door.

faq.q: What are Panviman's starting prices and room types?
faq.a: Prices start at around ฿2,800/night for the 28 sqm Superior Hotel · They rise through the Deluxe Hotel, Pool Villa (with a private pool) and Executive Pool Suite (88 sqm, sea view) · There are also family options such as the Family Cottage and Family Pool Villa · Rates swing with the season and Full Moon nights, so compare a few platforms before booking.

It's best for families, couples, or anyone wanting a private-beach, sea-view resort that's more affordable than the pure luxury pool villas · Rooms run from entry-level hotel rooms to pool villas, and there's a kids club and children's activities · It's less suited to guests who struggle with steps, those who care most about brand-new rooms, or anyone here for the Full Moon party, since it's far from Haad Rin.

faq.q: Is the resort very steep — are there transfers inside?
faq.a: Yes, it's genuinely steep · The resort is built in tiers from the clifftop down to the shore, so some sections involve a lot of steps, but golf buggies shuttle guests around all day · Call the front desk for a buggy between your room, the pools, restaurants and the beach · If you have mobility issues or are travelling with elderly guests, request a lower room near the beach and pool when you book.

faq.q: What is the beach in front of Panviman like — is it private?
faq.a: The stretch in front of the resort is a quiet, clear private section of Thong Nai Pan Noi, with white sand and calm water · There are free kayaks and snorkelling gear, ideal for paddling and snorkelling the reef along the shore · Note that fresh-water runoff sometimes mixes in along the beach, and the sea here can get choppy on some days, so check conditions before swimming.

faq.q: How far ahead should I book?
faq.a: During high season (December–March) and nights near the Full Moon, rooms fill fast and prices climb, so book 1–2 months ahead · Other times, 3–4 weeks is enough · Every platform offers a Free Cancellation option — choose that first, then compare prices across sites before confirming.
